notes: Curated buy links keyed by package_store.canonical_chip_id, covering the full physical-module catalog (each url opened and verified against that part on 2026-06-22). link_type semantics: 'official' = verified product page for that exact chip/part; 'representative' = a real, in-stock, beginner-buyable stand-in for a generic part with no single canonical SKU (button, led_single, buzzer, MQ gas, etc.) or where the exact maker board is discontinued; 'search_fallback' = no clean retail product page exists (niche China-only parts), so a labeled human-readable search URL (AliExpress where the part is actually sold, else Amazon) is provided rather than a fabricated product link. Maker stores (Adafruit/SparkFun/DFRobot/Pimoroni/Seeed/Waveshare/M5Stack) are preferred for URL stability; Amazon /dp/ASIN, eBay, DigiKey or AliExpress are used only when no maker SKU exists. Software-only catalog packages (mqtt, microflask, etc.) have empty capabilities and never surface as recommendation parts, so they intentionally have no entry here.
